config.mobscrouchandcrawl.title: Mobs Can Crouch And Crawl
config.mobscrouchandcrawl.server_note: These settings are used by the server. In singleplayer they apply to your world; on a dedicated server, edit config/mobscrouchandcrawl.json on the server instead.
config.mobscrouchandcrawl.enable_crouchi: A mob chasing a target crouches to get through gaps 1.5 blocks high.
config.mobscrouchandcrawl.enable_crawlin: A mob chasing a target crawls to get through gaps 1 block high.
config.mobscrouchandcrawl.crouch_speed.t: Movement speed while crouching, relative to walking (0.3 = 30%, same as a sneaking player).
config.mobscrouchandcrawl.crawl_speed.to: Movement speed while crawling, relative to walking (0.3 = 30%, same as a crawling player).
